business_problem: State Grid's 95598 service center faced heavy call volumes, limited channels, and rising pressure during demand peaks and outages, making it difficult to maintain service quality and scale customer support efficiently with manual operations alone.
solution_summary: State Grid and Baidu AI Cloud built an AI platform for the 95598 customer-service center using Baidu AI Cloud Intelligent Customer Service. The platform includes an AI foundation layer and an AI operations layer that together power three major application groups: intelligent customer service, intelligent agent support, and intelligent operations. Instead of relying only on voice calls, the design supports hotline, web, app, and SMS channels, with a shared group knowledge base so human agents and robots use the same governed service content. The deployment also includes maintenance-service scenarios piloted across four provincial networks, with dozens of multi-turn workflows and a ten-thousand-item FAQ corpus.
products_used: Baidu AI Cloud Intelligent Customer Service

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Runs the intelligent service, agent-assistance, and operations workflows across the 95598 support channels.

solution_components.name: AI Base Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the core AI capability layer used to support State Grid's customer-service applications.

solution_components.name: AI Operations Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates service operations, knowledge management, and ongoing optimization for the 95598 system.

data_flow: Customer requests arrive through hotline, website, app, and SMS channels and enter the 95598 AI service stack. Shared knowledge assets feed both the robot and agent-assistance layers, while service interactions flow into the operations platform for optimization, workload management, and ongoing scenario expansion.
business_outcome: State Grid expanded support across provinces and channels, reduced handling time and labor demand, and turned 95598 into a more scalable AI-assisted service operation.
metrics: The service is deployed in 27 provinces and cities.
Average daily phone volume is 60,000 calls.
Average daily interaction volume is 25 million messages.
